title: A Solarian-born Military ship strips its Mining Laser I and fits an Armor Plate II into its empty defence slot at confederacy_central_command
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-23 12:19 UTC (orders ENT-082, block APOPHIS: empire fits, strip mining lasers; O2: Crimson armor, Solarian accuracy; scorecard Module Fit & Purity).
